_comment: 20-01 — the seeded localhost origin the R4 separation is measured against.
Longest-prefix match; every unlisted path answers 200 {} on purpose (see
latency-proxy.py). The counts are the ONLY thing that matters here: they are
what MeasurementsRepository.kinds(withDataIn:) turns into availableKinds, and
an availableKinds that is non-empty is what puts the operator's missing
Insights sections back on the strip. Keys are the server MeasurementType
_comment_measurements: The recent page is seeded too, because `availableKinds` is only half of
`liveAvailableKinds` — the strip unions it with the kinds present in
`MeasurementsStore.recent`. Without this the pull-to-refresh row could not
tell 'the pull restored nothing' from 'the pull had nothing to restore'.
